location.zh: 赫尔卡星 雷伊特训（湖边）

capture.zh: 雷伊特训第5关：只能派自己的雷伊出战，胜利后雷伊学会「雷神天明闪」。

strategy_notes.zh: 完成前四项技能特训并将雷伊提升至100级。先用极光刃消除倒影的天然强化，再寻找机会使用雷神觉醒与攻击技能；须在四回合内击败1200体力的倒影。

engine_notes: The opponent is a blue mirror 雷伊 (镜影雷伊); a mirror of the player's 雷伊 at the player's level would be most faithful (script mirror_player_monster) — fixed Lv100 used here.

Superseded reconstruction: a later five-round shadow variant was previously selected. The current record explicitly chooses the earlier four-round/1200HP variant; the different period descriptions are not merged.
Pre-battle: if pirates are on the lake, shoot them with the head item first (map event).

雷伊特训 is a story line for the player's own 雷伊: only 雷伊 may fight (player_team_size 1 + require_player_species 70). The reward of each stage is a special skill learned by that 雷伊 (reward.learn_skill), not an essence; the engine needs a reward kind 'learn_skill {species, skill}' that adds the skill to the player's 雷伊's learnable list.
Skill ids 10823-10825 / 20363-20364 sit right after the 2009 skill range, so the training dates from late 2009 / early 2010.
Level 100 and HP 1200 are stated by 7k7k 2011-03-16 and match the official map-32 entry 雷伊技能特训之雷伊幻影.

The selected original-era shadow variant uses 1200 HP/four rounds from2011-03-16 report https://news.7k7k.com/content/20110316/76887.html; later 2013 guides report a five-round variant. Fixed IV 31/nature and four-action AI are calibration rather than recovered random IV/nature behavior.

Campaign audit correction: source-backed skill success requirement/reward mapping checked against official LeiyiTrainController.as and the period skill-training guide. The training 3/4 reward swap in the previous reconstruction is corrected.
Skills: the boss form 雷伊的幻影 (2013 id 2505, modern 5005) knows only 雷神天明闪 (3 PP). Species 70 stands in for the form, which has 雷伊's type and base stats.
source_note: 7k7k 2011-07 雷伊解析 lists the five 特训 opponents and how to beat them; baidu jingyan gives the skill order and the 5-turn shadow limit.
